+"""`lamina sections`: print information about a config file."""
+
+import sys
+
+from lamina.parser import parse
+
+
+def cmd_sections(argv: list[str], *, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    """Run the sections command; return the exit code."""
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append("--")
+    if len(argv) != 1:
+        print("usage: lamina sections FILE", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    with open(argv[0], encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        source_text = fh.read()
+    doc = parse(source_text, source=argv[0])
+    for section in doc.sections():
+        print(f"{section.name}: {len(section.entries())}")
+    return 0
